items.title: Emmanuel Sayles Interview, 1979-12-05
items.q: And we had a trip with Kit Thomas. Concert tour.

ctx.x: Just a few pickpockets, that's all. Nothing serious?

No, well, I'm talking about getting injured. Yeah. Right now and today, my wife and I'm hired, we stay right here. I don't go nowhere. We just do things. It's a pretty fair neighborhood. I mean, my wife and all those things like that. I mean, when she was there, I mean, if she wanted to go, she went a lot of places to me. You know, years past, but years changed the thing. I took a trip to her. We used to have that trip going to New York for Newport Festival. I took her on one there and she really enjoyed herself.…
What was the first time I went to?
